scope: Deterministic evaluation of the reviewed corpus' PredicateTaskList and By* AST families: boolean composition, target/team checks, modifier/flag presence, dynamic-value comparisons, random chance, HP/HP-ratio comparisons, wave/challenge/rank checks and turn identity checks. Weakness, summon-relation and other special hooks reject until their provider packets exist.

evidence.support: E4 EvaluatorSpec/FixPoint comparison leaf primitives and the deferred TaskContext.Evaluate(bool) dispatcher boundary.
44 distinct predicate source types and 515 lifted Predicate AST nodes supply the argument shapes for the selected evaluator.
target aliases used inside predicates resolve through TARGET-001.
CompareValue and Chance expressions evaluate through the PostfixExpr decoder.

selected_model.composition: ByAnd/ByAny evaluate their PredicateList children in order with short-circuit; ByNot evaluates exactly one singular Predicate child and inverts it.
selected_model.comparison: Equal/NotEqual/Less/LessEqual/Greater/GreaterEqual operate on Decimal values with exact comparison.
selected_model.inverse: A top-level Inverse field on any predicate inverts its result after evaluation.
selected_model.target_facts: ByTargetTeam, ByIsContainModifier, ByContainBehaviorFlag and ByIsTargetValid resolve their TargetType via TARGET-001; missing target lists are false, never guessed.
selected_model.dynamic_facts: ByCompareDynamicValue uses ContextScope and DynamicKey with the DynamicValue store; missing keys reject.
selected_model.random: ByRandomChance samples the kernel RNG exactly once per evaluation; chance is clamped to [0,1].
selected_model.ordering: Predicate evaluation happens at its containing task boundary; any RNG consumption is recorded in the deterministic trace.

unsupported_cases: weakness/somato-type/summon/param-string facts are supplied by explicit provider hooks; provider implementations themselves remain separate packets
callback-name/flag matching uses explicit context fields, not a global dispatcher
acceptance_fixture: tests/game_data/test_predicate_semantics_reference.py proves boolean composition, dynamic/modifier/flag checks, target/HP checks, and explicit unsupported rejection.
dsh_implementation_contract: Implement predicates as immutable AST evaluation with short-circuit order and Decimal comparisons. Unsupported predicate types reject the containing behavior; no predicate may silently evaluate to false.
